description.en: Experimental palette for the Xespirito archetype, emphasizing functional awareness, diagnosis, clarity and guided sentence repair.
description.es: Paleta experimental para el arquetipo Xespirito, con énfasis en conciencia funcional, diagnóstico, claridad y reparación guiada de oraciones.
description.pt: Paleta experimental para o arquétipo Xespirito, enfatizando consciência funcional, diagnóstico, clareza e reparo guiado de sentenças.

recommended: Use blue to indicate active functional analysis and diagnosis.
Use gold to mark guided repair and validated grammatical relationships.
Use amber selectively to signal functional conflict without visual overload.
avoid: Do not use this palette to replace established pedagogical word-class colors.
Do not treat candidate colors as canonical until visual homologation.
